newsitem.title: USA: Data Broadcasting seeks sale of two units.
newsitem.headline: Data Broadcasting seeks sale of two units.

text.p: Data Broadcasting Corp on Thursday said it has engaged investment bankers to assist in the sale of its CheckRite International and Instore Satellite Network divisions.
The proposed sales are expected to achieve a significant cash realization for the company, the firm said.
The sales will enable the firm to concentrate its efforts and resources on Data Broadcasting's core businesses and their significant expansion opportunities.
The expected cash proceeds may be used for acquisitions that would be complementary to Data Broadcasting's core financial information services businesses, the company said.

The company said that the sales process is expected to be implemented within the next 30 days. Results of the two divisions will be treated as discontinued operations for reporting purposes in the third fiscal quarter ended March 31, 1997, which the company expects to report in early May.
